tool_args.rationale: The short-horizon observations are positive and consistent with early gain, but cannot resolve the slow adaptation term that drives reversal at the requested long horizon. Acquire the slow-horizon discriminating probe before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-horizon reversal model from the five short-horizon rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The short-horizon data do not identify the slow component well enough to forecast reliably at H≈20.7.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The current rows have s_grad=0 throughout, so the sink coupling is untested; the prescribed slow-horizon probe is the relevant next measurement.
More fine-resolution short-range data are less informative than a measurement at a discriminating long horizon.
It is irrelevant to distinguishing the candidate mechanisms.
